column1: # Sonic Frontiers Definitive Edition (SEGA / Sonic Team, Switch 2), v65536 = 1.0.0 on the title screen, SDK 21.4.1 (Ounce), NVN2, Hedgehog Engine 2, CRIWARE.
# From the NSP script's provisional profile, with depth_mode added (README.md).
# the dump holds the whole game as update v65536 (its base folder has the same code modules)
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 9216 MB heap region
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# 1,554 shaders in Needle containers (NVN2 records) in main and 3,404 more in raw/NeedleShader.pac (a PACx 403 archive); the game's other 1,434 archives hold none
# the game sets near = 0 at boot ("depth mode near=0" in the log): the pipeline bases made before it runs take the main0_z vertex entries. Without the key the NSP script's prebuild made
# them for near = -w and the first start built all 2,576 pairs again, 25 s before its first frame
# used memory for the current rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB
